asset_scope: Unchanged publisher search demo dev100, not full DuReader or Zhidao
selection: full original dev file order, positions0..99; fixed ranges of at least3 also supported
model_profile: Existing Qwen3.5-27B native non-thinking chat template, BF16 TP2 Ascend NPU
input: Original question and every original document title/paragraph, no oracle selection or truncation
budget_boundary: Declared generative fallback configuration. Publisher old extractive baseline has no autoregressive LLM token budget. No official quality reproduction or cross-model ranking claim.
output: Original prediction JSON fields answers/yesno_answers/entity_answers; attach original identity/type as task metadata, never infer these from gold answers
malformed_output: Retain raw response, no repair or retry; missing native prediction scored under publisher rules
scoring: Original main/all/description/entity/yesno functions and BLEU/ROUGE-L/entity P/R/F1; explicit Python3 dictionary snapshot/key-order compatibility only
small_dataset_policy: Full100 original demo dev tasks rather than only3; train100 preserved for preparation/consumer, not mislabeled as test cases
